SELECT 
  ac."ARTregID",
  ac."art_title",
  ac."DYNASTY",
  ROUND(
    (CAST(ar."HIST_sign" AS numeric) + 
     CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score') AS numeric) + 
     CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score') AS numeric)) * 
    (10 - CASE ac."conserve_status"
      WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
      WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
      WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
      WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
      WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
      ELSE NULL
    END) / 30, 2
  ) as CPI_score,
  CASE 
    WHEN (CAST(ar."HIST_sign" AS numeric) + 
          CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score') AS numeric) + 
          CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score') AS numeric)) * 
         (10 - CASE ac."conserve_status"
           WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
           WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
           WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
           WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
           WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
           ELSE NULL
         END) / 30 > 7 THEN 'High Priority'
    WHEN (CAST(ar."HIST_sign" AS numeric) + 
          CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'research_score') AS numeric) + 
          CAST((ar."rating_profile"->>'cultural_score') AS numeric)) * 
         (10 - CASE ac."conserve_status"
           WHEN 'Excellent' THEN 1
           WHEN 'Good' THEN 3
           WHEN 'Fair' THEN 5
           WHEN 'Poor' THEN 7
           WHEN 'Critical' THEN 10
           ELSE NULL
         END) / 30 BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Medium Priority'
    ELSE 'Low Priority'
  END as priority_level
FROM "ArtifactsCore" ac
JOIN "ArtifactRatings" ar ON ac."ARTregID" = ar."ART_link"

    WHEN cpi_score BETWEEN 4 AND 7 THEN 'Medium Priority'
